title: Neural Residual Modeling for Scientific Data Compression under Guaranteed Error Bounds
abstract: arXiv:2609.23185v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lossy compression of scientific simulation data increasingly relies on learned, latent-space architectures such as Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), which iteratively quantize a base representation and its residuals to progressively reduce reconstruction error. While effective, RVQ performs this residual modeling entirely in latent space, leaving the pixel-space error structure of the reconstruction largely unaddressed. In this work, we propose a post-processing pipeline that augments an RVQ-based compressor with a U-Net trained to predict and correct pixel-space residuals between the original volume and its RVQ reconstruction. We show that these residuals are spatially structured rather than driven by local intensity or gradient features, motivating the need for a deep spatial model rather than simple statistical correction. translated_title: 保证误差界限下用于科学数据压缩的神经残差建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.23185v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：科学仿真数据的有损压缩越来越依赖于学习型潜在空间架构，例如残差向量量化（RVQ），它通过迭代量化基础表示及其残差来逐步降低重建误差。尽管有效，RVQ完全在潜在空间中进行残差建模，使得重建结果的像素空间误差结构在很大程度上未被处理。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个后处理流水线，通过一个训练用于预测并校正原始体数据与其RVQ重建结果之间像素空间残差的U-Net，来增强基于RVQ的压缩器。我们证明这些残差在空间上是有结构的，而非由局部强度或梯度特征所驱动，这说明了需要深度空间模型而非简单统计校正的必要性。经U-Net校正后的重建结果随后通过一个保证自编码器（GAE）阶段，该阶段将……
tldr: 提出了一种结合U-Net像素空间残差校正与保证自编码器（GAE）的后处理流水线，在保证误差界限的前提下显著提升基于RVQ的科学数据压缩重建质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes a post-processing pipeline that combines U-Net-based pixel-space residual correction with a Guaranteed Autoencoder to improve RVQ-based scientific data compression reconstruction quality under guaranteed error bounds.
